title: Sleeping Beauty: The Story of Briar Rose
galleryTitle: Sleeping Beauty: The Story of Briar Rose
author: Brothers Grimm
descriptionEn: A rich, beginner-friendly English retelling of the Brothers Grimm tale Little Briar Rose. Nine chapters with full scenes and dialogue: the twelve gifts, the thirteenth wise woman, the spindle, the hundred years and the hedge of thorns, with a vocabulary guide.
descriptionPt: Um reconto rico e acessível, em inglês simples, de A Bela Adormecida (Rosinha do Espinheiro) dos Irmãos Grimm. Nove capítulos: os doze dons, a décima terceira sábia, o fuso, os cem anos e a sebe de espinhos, com guia de vocabulário.
adaptationCredit: Adapted for beginner learners (A1) for Bookmoo. New text written from the structure of the Grimm tale; not a copy of any published translation.
sources: Brothers Grimm, Kinder- und Haus-Märchen, KHM 50 'Dornröschen' (1st ed. 1812; final text 1857). Read in the historical English translation in Project Gutenberg #2591 (Edgar Taylor / Marian Edwardes, titled 'Briar Rose'); the German tale's frog is used in place of that translation's fish. Perrault (1697) and Basile (1634) are only historical context.
rights: Original tale: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm died in 1863 and 1859, so the work is in the public domain worldwide. The adaptation is new original text written for Bookmoo and copies no translation. It uses no names, songs, designs or characters from film versions. Cover: original artwork made for Bookmoo.
